mutants.name: detail_ignored
mutants.old: if r == "failed", why == "not_submitted" || why == "not_typed", (o["detail"] as? String)?.contains("taken back out") == true { return (r, why! + "_back") }
mutants.new: if r == "failed", why == "not_submitted" || why == "not_typed", (o["detail"] as? String)?.contains("") == false { return (r, why! + "_back") }

mutants.name: detail_any_result
mutants.old: if r == "failed", why == "not_submitted" || why == "not_typed", (o["detail"] as? String)?.contains("taken back out") == true { return (r, why! + "_back") }
mutants.new: if why == "not_submitted" || why == "not_typed", (o["detail"] as? String)?.contains("taken back out") == true { return (r, why! + "_back") }

mutants.name: left_arm_says_not_run
mutants.old: case ("failed"?, "not_submitted"?) where shell, ("failed"?, "not_typed"?) where shell: return AgentWindowText.shellLeft
mutants.new: case ("failed"?, "not_submitted"?) where shell, ("failed"?, "not_typed"?) where shell: return AgentWindowText.shellNotRun

mutants.name: left_arm_plain_too
mutants.old: case ("failed"?, "not_submitted"?) where shell, ("failed"?, "not_typed"?) where shell: return AgentWindowText.shellLeft
